subject.title: Slack Socket Mode events not reaching Gateway despite full config per documentation

question: Should this issue wait for redacted current-main Slack Socket Mode diagnostics before narrowing or closing it against the reaction-specific Slack issue?
rationale: The public report points to a local file that is unavailable here, and that missing evidence determines whether this is reaction-only, broad Socket Mode liveness, shared-connection routing, or a later OpenClaw filter.

options.title: Keep open pending diagnostics
options.body: Ask for a redacted `openclaw channels status --probe --json`, Gateway trace logs, and any raw Socket Mode envelope or shared-connection warning from current main before changing code or closing.

options.title: Duplicate after local report confirms reactions only
options.body: If the missing report is only about reaction add/remove events with the same zero-envelope symptom, route the remaining work to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/56653.

options.title: Close later if no report is recoverable
options.body: If the reporter cannot provide the referenced diagnostics and no maintainer can reproduce the failure, a later stale-insufficient-info close would be safer than a source-level guess.

recommendation.title: Keep open pending diagnostics
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted `openclaw channels status --probe --json`, Gateway trace logs, and any raw Socket Mode envelope or shared-connection warning from current main before changing code or closing.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for the central Slack monitor and mismatch-filter path is steipete's shortlog and `dadef27d7aba` filter work.
